Meet the crew

HTCC. Christchurch's first and only HYROX-only club.

It's not just a club — it's friends & family. A crew that trains together at ROXBOX in Mudeford, travels to races together (Málaga, Glasgow, Manchester, Cardiff…) and ends up in the same bar after. Run by Ross — Level 1 HYROX Performance Coach, three seasons, 14 races, 60+ athletes coached, 2 podiums.

"Authenticity is a deep value of mine & it's harder to come by these days. I love this sport — it's become my passion and my entire living."

• Level 1 HYROX Performance Coach — 10+ years coaching, ex-national swimmer, Ironman
  • Solo 1:24:34 → 1:10:32 · Doubles 0:59:19 (Dublin, with Steve)
  • 3 seasons · 14 races · 60+ athletes coached · 2 podiums
alt="Ross Fisher coaching the Sunday Community Sesh at ROXBOX, Christchurch"

Never raced? Hooked already? Either way, start at the Sunday Community Sesh — 8am, race-style, the most popular hour of the week. Then pick your weeknights: Rebel, Lift, Engine, Run Club. Nobody's judging. Everyone here was new once — then they got hooked from that first race.
Sunday Service 8–9am · Rebel, Lift, Engine & Run Club through the week · race trips together · crew WhatsApp · £15 drop-in, non-members welcome. Join us — or be left in the dust.

Away for work or carrying a knock? Classes don't expire week to week — use your pack when you're back. Online coaching carries on wherever you are.

How do classes work?

Classes run at ROXBOX — the HYROX floor inside GTC Health Clubs, Advantage Padel, Christchurch Business Park, Mudeford BH23 4FL. Race-grade kit, room for 32. GTC base membership plus a class pack (4, 8, 12 or 16), or £15 drop-in if you're not a member. Book in the GTC app.
Not ready to race? Come watch with the crew — free, still a great day out.
Three things per station that Ross actually does on race day — including the embarrassing ones. Spot a gap? Ask Ross — it might make the list.

Booked flights and a hotel for your next race? Post your trip — others can join in: same flight, same hotel, split a room, or just travel to the venue together. Nothing booked yet? Post anyway — join someone's trip. Ross makes the intro, your number stays private.

faq.json.note: Receptionist answers — the 10 questions HTC Christchurch gets asked most. Instant answers in the Ask section; anything else goes to the inbox.

items.a: Drop-in is £15 for non-members. Members: GTC base membership £44.10/mo plus a class pack — 4 classes £35.99 (8, 12, 16 packs too), so from about £80/mo. Online coaching with Ross is £150/mo; doubles coaching £100 each.
Easiest way in is a £15 drop-in — Sunday Community Sesh at 8am is the one most people try first. Non-members welcome.

items.q: I've never done HYROX — can beginners join?
items.a: That's most of the room, honestly. Every station scales, nobody's watching your numbers, and Ross will tell you the same: show up twice a week and the rest takes care of itself.

An indoor fitness race: eight 1km runs with a workout station between each — SkiErg, sled push, sled pull, burpee broad jumps, row, farmers carry, lunges, wall balls. Open, Pro, Doubles and Relay divisions, so everyone can race.
ROXBOX at GTC Health Clubs, inside Advantage Padel — Unit 20, Christchurch Business Park, Radar Way, Mudeford, Christchurch BH23 4FL. Free parking on site.
Mon Rebel 6:15am & 6:30pm · Tue Lift 6:15am, Run Club 6:30pm · Wed Run Club 6:15am, Lift 6:30pm · Thu Engine 6:15am & 6:30pm · Sun HYROX Community Sesh 8–9am.

items.q: Do you run HYROX sim days?
items.a: Yes — full race simulations with real timing and transitions, the closest thing to race day without the ticket. Members get first shout; dates land on the events page.

Yes — 1:1 coaching is on the plans. Technique work, race prep, or just faster progress than group sessions alone. Message Ross directly and you'll get a straight answer on whether it's worth it for you.
Rolling monthly — cancel whenever, no exit forms, no guilt-trip retention script. If you leave, the door stays open.

items.q: I'm looking for a doubles partner
items.a: Post a card on the find-a-partner board — pace band, race target, one line about you. Ross matches people by hand, because doubles is chemistry, not just split times.
